_comment: US Bancorp FY2025 (data/edgar/USB.json) plus illustrative market inputs (risk-free = 10yr UST, ERP = Damodaran implied ERP, beta = illustrative for a regional bank). Cost of equity (CAPM) is what feeds the residual-income valuation for a bank; the debt/WACC side of this file is included for comparability with the other three sector checks but residual income uses cost of equity only.
